title: Proportional column breathing and density modes for mixed-content virtual tables
creator: Priya Desai
description:
Problem: Our current virtual table implementation uses rigid column snap heuristics which lead to clipped content, unexpected wrapping, and jarring density transitions when users resize columns or toggle compact modes. This is especially visible for mixed-content tables (text, icons, badges, multi-line notes) used across the Console.

Goal: Introduce a ‘proportional breathing’ model where column width adjustments and density mode changes interpolate smoothly based on column content priority and runtime measurements. The feature should preserve virtualization perf, remain keyboard- and screen-reader-friendly, and provide telemetry to guide future tuning.

Proposed approach: 1) Define a per-column priority and min/ideal/max width tokens in the design system. 2) On resize or density toggle, compute a proportional redistribution of available width (breathing) rather than snapping fixed presets. 3) Use a short animated transition (150ms) to make changes feel continuous. 4) Add an accessible announcement pattern that summarizes the change for screen readers (e.g., "Column widths updated: Name 180px, Status 120px"). 5) Work with Eng to expose a lightweight runtime measurement API so the layout engine can read content overflow probabilities without fully hydrating every cell.

Success metrics: reduction in manual column adjustments (telemetry), fewer clipped cells reported in support channels, higher satisfaction in design QA, no measurable regression in render latency (target: <5% p95 render).

Constraints & trade-offs: - Complexity of proportional algorithm vs simple snapping. We avoid full layout hydration to preserve virtualization, so algorithm will rely on aggregated content statistics + conservative min widths. - Animated transitions must be short to not hurt perceived CPU on low-end machines. - Edge cases where a single extremely long field requires overflow handling (ellipsis + tooltip).
acceptance_criteria: Design tokens defined: min/ideal/max width patterns and density spacing tokens documented in the design system page
Prototype in Figma demonstrating proportional breathing for 3 mixed-content table layouts
Accessible announcement pattern and keyboard-resize interaction documented and reviewed by Accessibility team
Telemetry spec agreed with Eng: events for density_toggle, column_resize, clipped_cell_count, avg_column_width_distribution
Frontend experiment toggled behind feature flag; no >5% regression in p95 render latency on internal perf harness
